blurb: Guests board tropical tiki boats for 2 hour BYOB cruises up and down the Cuyahoga River and Inner Harbor. The boats have USCG safety equipment and a designated driver. A first mate acts as photographer and entertainer.

quotes.text: Just wrapped up my birthday event on the Tiki Barge...BEST TIME I’VE HAD ON THE LAKE!!! Super friendly staff, beautiful route through our city!!! Would 1000% recommend!!!
We had a fantastic time on the Big Kahuna! The crew was fantastic! The views were great! Highly recommend and would love to do it again!
If you like to have fun with friends and see AWESOME views of Cleveland then this is a must do trip! We had a great time!
Definitely a highlight of our summer! Great views along the river and friendly staff.
